formulas: Net area = length × height × count − total opening area.
Theoretical bricks = masonry volume / nominal brick volume.
Nominal brick volume = (length + joint) × (width + joint) × (height + joint).
Wet mortar = masonry volume − theoretical bricks × actual brick volume.
Cement bags = cement volume × assumed bulk density / bag mass.
Dry mortar = wet mortar × dry-volume factor × (1 + wastage/100), split by the selected ratio.
notes: Opening area is the total across all elements. Each plaster face is a separate surface.
Idealized brick-and-joint geometry; bond, frogs, breakage pattern and edge effects are not modelled.
Dry-volume factor, cement density, bag mass and nominal ratios are user-selected estimating assumptions.
Wastage is applied once. No automatic code-specific measurement deductions are made.
